name: siteos
description: One SiteOS plugin for common Projects, Auth, Pulse, Cookie, Forms, Search, Trace, SEO/GEO, Integrations and analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Operate SiteOS with MCP, CLI and focused skills
interface.longDescription: Select one website Project and work across SiteOS with remote MCP reads, a CLI for local workflows and CI, and focused skills with explicit configuration, publication and runtime verification.
defaultPrompt: $siteos set up SiteOS for this repository and route the work to the required services
$siteos-cli inspect CLI readiness and available commands
$siteos-auth authenticate and select the correct Organization
$siteos-search inspect this external project and configure managed search
$siteos-forms add a managed contact form to this project
$siteos-analytics configure website analytics and verify a custom event
$siteos-cookie configure the consent banner for this Project
$siteos-seo complete SEO/GEO setup, research and verified improvements for this website
$siteos-integrations inspect Organization connections and notification destinations
